purpose: Audit public docs.wagtail.org with current stable English documentation, search, tutorials, reference, release notes and contributor guidance; evaluate bounded public qualitative evidence.

pages.task: Follow the first-site tutorial and identify prerequisites
Look up a Page QuerySet method
Find image documentation in full search results
Understand major release and upgrade changes

journeys.task: Search for images from the homepage and reach the complete responsive-image guide

contextScopes.access-barriers: Anonymous English desktop readers with JavaScript enabled, using pointer interaction and text entry: search from the stable homepage for images and reach complete responsive-image documentation without authentication or personal-data submission. Keyboard-only, assistive-technology, constrained-network and non-English completion are outside this task.
contextScopes.content-lifecycle: English Wagtail developer documentation through the publicly documented Wagtail 8.0 release: assess release-linked maintenance policy, a documented applied update/removal, and continued discoverability of v7.0 historical image guidance. Judge lifecycle rather than whether old supported documentation should be deleted.
contextScopes.audience-needs: The current public decision to organize Wagtail developer documentation into tutorial, how-to, reference and explanation modes: inspect audience rationale and public evidence that user research informed or validated that decision. No internal research or representative-user testing records supplied.
contextScopes.sustainability-goals: Published goals and progress specifically for docs.wagtail.org as available in its current sustainability-considerations page and disclosure collection. Distinguish advice for Wagtail-powered websites and CMS-wide work from documentation-host-specific targets, boundaries and comparable results.

contextEvidence.limitations: One agent walkthrough; not keyboard-only or representative-user testing
Publisher policy, not proof all rules applied

contextEvidence.scope: Release cadence, branches and documentation backport policy
contextEvidence.limitations: Release policy is not a complete editorial audit schedule

contextEvidence.scope: Applied documentation updates and deprecated-setting removal
contextEvidence.limitations: Publisher self-report, not independently traced through Git history

contextEvidence.scope: Public v7.0 image documentation remains accessible
contextEvidence.limitations: Availability verified, historical audience not measured

contextEvidence.scope: Four documentation modes and stated audiences

contextEvidence.limitations: CMS-wide advice does not establish documentation-specific goals

questions.question: Can maintainers provide docs-host-specific sustainability goals/progress and a research record behind documentation modes?
questions.reason: Optional evidence; public audit proceeds with unknowns.

assumptions: Desktop first-load headline; narrow viewport and preferences are supplementary
No form submission or account change unless explicitly scoped
Root resolves to /en/stable/; English stable-version sample for the origin.
No cookie banner observed in rendered browsing; no_banner branch has no action.
Only public read-only search/navigation; no accounts or personal data.
Standard collection records first load, waiting/scroll and repeat phases.
Exploratory browsing is setup evidence, not measured performance.
ownerPriorities: Fresh per-site report with broader qualitative WSG coverage
First-load headline with post-interaction and scroll measurements
Useful priorities and explicit next evidence requests

sampling.discovery: Live root redirect and rendered navigation; all nine pages returned HTTP200.
sampling.cookieControls: No banner or blocking consent observed on sampled rendered pages.
sampling.verifiedJourney: #searchinput images + Enter opened embedded results; unique a.hit-block-heading[href="/en/stable/topics/images.html"] opened responsive-images section.
